method:
Review the adopted Workbench/graph map using actual mGBA input.

Each reference position is harvested by loading the actual generated room.
Visited/inventory/completion state and safe transitions are disclosed fixtures.
No menu focus, zoom, canvas, marker report, animation pose or output pixel is
assigned. The immutable ROM must contain the current map diagnostics.
seed: 0xB4A7 all-room comparison, first naturally generated shrine seed recorded below, and seed11 fog

limits: Natural room navigation uses transition fixtures; no UI canvas/image/pose assignment. Authored complete art coverage and gameplay visual captures are separate evidence. No generic yes/no screen exists; actual shop/title choices are captured.
fixtures: Seed, inventory/resources, enemy removal, safe transition/position, visited and completion flags only. Presentation is controlled by real buttons.

publication.method: Active media are unchanged copies of approved frozen-ROM mGBA output. Local raw all-frame directories and inexact GIFs are archival only.
